lingual-braces.text: Users choose lingual braces to straighten teeth without visible brackets on the front surfaces, so the smile improves while treatment is under way. Alignment by braces is well studied; forum posters also discuss face-shape changes with extractions, which is based on anecdote.

miswak-chew-stick.text: Miswak is used as a traditional natural toothbrush, and some people also use it hoping for cleaner, whiter-looking teeth. Small trials have looked at plaque reduction; whitening specifically is untested.

chain: Tinted or ringed lens over iris
Eye colour or iris size changes
colored-circle-contact-lenses.text: Users wear colored lenses to change eye colour, and circle lenses to make the iris look larger, an effect that is visible as soon as they are worn. Forum posters debate how much it adds to overall attractiveness, which is based on opinion rather than studies.

foot-orthotic-insoles.text: Some insoles are sold for added height, which is measurable while worn, and others for comfort, gait or arch support that people hope will improve posture and standing presence. Trials cover heel pain; posture and looks effects are untested.

gynecomastia-compression-vest.text: Men wear compression vests to flatten the chest so that gynecomastia is less visible under shirts, with the change showing immediately. The vest conceals rather than treats the tissue, and no studies test it.

spray-tan-booth.text: Users book spray-tan booths for an even, bronzed colour without UV exposure, visible within hours and fading over about a week. The colour change is well established; inhalation of the mist has not been studied in humans.

bronzer.text: Bronzer gives an instant tanned look for the day and washes off, and people use it on the face to match a body tan or add warmth. The tint is visible as soon as it is applied.

gradual-tanning-lotion.text: Gradual tanning lotions are used to build a natural-looking tan over several days, with a slight colour change usually visible after the first application. The colour deepens with repeated use and is a visible, measurable change.

tanning-accelerator.text: Users apply or take tanning accelerators hoping to darken faster during UV exposure. The melanin-boosting claim is untested, and users report skin effects such as acne and rashes.

chain: Fewer wrinkles and spots over time
upf-clothing.text: UPF clothing is worn as a no-reapplication way to limit sun exposure, which is promoted for keeping skin looking younger. The fabric's UV blocking is lab-rated; its effect on visible aging has not been studied directly.

light-box-sad-lamp.text: Users run light boxes in winter to lift mood and keep sleep and energy steady, which they connect to looking more rested. The evidence is for seasonal depression; effects on appearance are untested.

mattress-medium-firm.text: People choose a medium-firm mattress for comfortable sleep and spinal support, which forums link to better posture and a more rested look. Sleep research links it to less back pain; facial or skeletal effects are untested.

home-uvb-booth.text: Some users consider home UVB booths for tanning without much burning, drawing on their use for dermatology phototherapy. The device is established for skin conditions; cosmetic tanning use has not been studied.

chain: Dark circles and blemishes blend away
concealer-for-men.text: Men use concealer to cover under-eye circles, blemishes and redness, and the evened-out tone is visible straight away. Looksmaxxing posters rate it a low-cost option, and male-specific research is limited.

eyebrow-pencil-powder.text: Pencils and powders fill gaps and define brow shape for a fuller look, visible as soon as applied. They are a daily-wear cosmetic used to frame the eyes.

hair-styling-clay-pomade.text: Clay and pomade are used to shape and hold hair, giving matte texture or a slick shine that is visible immediately. They are styling aids for presentation, with no clinical research behind them.

cologne-perfume.text: Users wear cologne for a pleasant scent and a stronger impression in person. It is popular in grooming circles, and published trials of its effect on attractiveness were not found.

rhinoplasty.text: Rhinoplasty is discussed as the main facial-harmony operation, used to change the nose's shape and size, and the result is visibly and measurably different after healing. The idea that nose changes shift the whole face is based on opinion.

bimaxillary-osteotomy-bimax.text: Bimax repositions both jaws and is sought for bite and airway problems as well as for changing facial proportions, with visible skeletal change after healing. The structural operation is established; the cosmetic results forums describe vary by case.

lefort-1-maxillary-advancement.text: LeFort 1 advances the upper jaw and is discussed for adding midface projection, with the bone movement visible and measurable. The operation is standard for bite problems; claims of under-eye support rest mostly on bite and cleft research.

maxillomandibular-advancement-mma.text: MMA moves both jaws forward and is marketed online as a looks-plus-airway upgrade, with the forward movement visible in profile. It is an established sleep-apnoea operation; its cosmetic use is studied less.

jaw-surgery-orthognathic.text: Orthognathic surgery is seen as the big structural lever for recessed jaws, asymmetry and bite problems, and the bone movement is visibly measurable. It is a recognised surgical field, and forum accounts report varying cosmetic satisfaction.

chin-implant-genioplasty.text: Chin implants and sliding genioplasty add or reposition chin projection to balance the profile, with the change visible after healing. Both are routine surgeries, and forums describe bone sliding as the larger change.

jaw-implants.text: Jaw implants are used to widen and define the lower jaw, a visible change used in facial gender surgery and cosmetic work. Reviews note that more outcome research is needed.

cheek-implants.text: Cheek implants add fullness or projection over the cheekbone, and the new contour is visible after healing. Reviews report high satisfaction, but trial-grade evidence is limited.

buccal-fat-removal.text: Buccal fat removal is sought for a slimmer, more sculpted lower midface, a permanent change visible after swelling settles. Reviews report a 25% pooled complication rate, and no randomised trials exist.

lateral-canthoplasty.text: Lateral canthoplasty is used medically for lid laxity and is now sought by people who want a more upward-tilted outer eye corner, which is a visible change. No studies test it for that cosmetic goal.

hunter-eyes-surgery.text: Hunter eyes surgery is community slang for combined procedures meant to produce a deep-set, positively tilted eye look, visible after healing. No study tests that specific goal.

orbital-decompression.text: Orbital decompression is discussed as a way to get deeper-set eyes, with the eye position change visible after surgery. Its established use is thyroid eye disease; cosmetic deep-setting has no trials.

chain: Excess lid skin and fat removed
blepharoplasty.text: Blepharoplasty is used to reduce hooding and under-eye bags, with the result visible once swelling settles. It is established for those concerns; looksmaxxing-specific eye-shape goals have no trials.
